answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the sable is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the prism of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
